title: Fainting (Syncope)
immediate_warning: If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.

immediate_warning_translations.en: If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person does not regain consciousness within 1 minute, call 112.

description: Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.

description_translations.en: Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Fainting is a brief loss of consciousness caused by a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It is usually harmless but can indicate a serious condition.

signs: Pale or grey skin before fainting

1.en: Pale or grey skin before fainting
1.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Pale or grey skin before fainting
1.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Pale or grey skin before fainting
1.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Pale or grey skin before fainting
1.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Pale or grey skin before fainting

steps.instruction: Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.

instruction_translations.en: Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person flat on the ground on their back.

steps.instruction: Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.

instruction_translations.en: Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Raise their legs about 30cm (12 inches) to improve blood flow to the brain.

steps.instruction: Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.

instruction_translations.en: Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.

steps.instruction: Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.

instruction_translations.en: Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, begin CPR and call 112.

steps.instruction: When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.

instruction_translations.en: When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] When they recover, have them sit up slowly. Do not let them stand immediately.

do_not: Do not give water until fully conscious.

0.en: Do not give water until fully conscious.
0.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not give water until fully conscious.

0.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not give water until fully conscious.
0.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not give water until fully conscious.

hospital_threshold: Go to hospital if fainting recurs, the person has heart disease, or there is chest pain.
